provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Lost Ruins of Arnak rulebook (Czech Games Edition)

modules.name: Snake Temple side
modules.note: Bird Temple side is recommended for a first game.

steps.text: Main board {side} up
Shuffle the Artifacts facedown on their marked space
Fear cards faceup on their marked space
Shuffle the Items facedown on their marked space
Moon staff in the card row on round I
{a} artifact faceup left of the moon staff, {i} items faceup right of it
Mix the Idol tiles; each level-1 site (the 7 sites) gets one faceup idol
Each of the 8 level-2 sites gets one faceup and one facedown idol, as shown on the board
Shuffle the blocking tiles facedown, flip 3: block the space at each of those 3 sites; box the other 2
Block all 5 marked spaces - each of those sites holds only one archaeologist
Temple tile stacks of {n} each: one 11-point stack at the top, two 6-point in the middle, three 2-point at the bottom; box the rest
Shuffle the research bonus tiles facedown; a stack of {n} at the top of the research track
One bonus tile on most research spaces (spaces marked for 3+ or 4 players only as marked); turn them faceup, box the rest
Deal {n} random assistants to the Assistant Rescue space (top one public)
Deal 2 or 3 bonus tiles to the Dreadful Tales row as marked
All resource tokens on the supply board
Shuffle the level-1 and level-2 site tiles separately; facedown on the supply board
Shuffle the guardians facedown on the supply board
Assistants silver side up, shuffled into 3 stacks of 4
Remaining assistants silver side up: two stacks of 3, the third with all the rest
Each player takes a player board, research tokens, 2 archaeologists and 4 basic cards in their color
Research tokens on a starting space below the track; magnifying glass atop the notebook
Starting deck: 2 Funding, 2 Exploration + 2 Fear cards, shuffled facedown on your board
Starting player marker to whoever most recently visited somewhere new; play is clockwise
Starting resources: P1 2 coins, P2 1 coin + 1 compass, P3 2 coins + 1 compass, P4 1 coin + 2 compasses
Board set up as for 2 players; you play second (1 coin, 1 compass)
Rival: another player board, gray-tents side, with all 6 archaeologists not in your color
Rival's magnifying glass on a starting space next to your research tokens
Rival action stack of 10 tiles: all 5 archaeologist tiles + 5 red or green tiles
5 rounds; each round starts by drawing up to 5 cards
Crossing the research bridge costs 1 idol from your crates
The rival starts every round and doesn't pass until all 10 tiles are played
Everyone draws 5 cards; the starting player takes the first turn
